scope: Metadata-only preparation for a later prospectively fixed SAM2 candidate-ownership-mask pilot; this file authorizes no pixel reads or model calls.
frame_cohort: Exactly the original 20 V92 selected frame records and 160 original ordered query records. Preserve image identity, q, L, candidate index, raw folds, validity and failures.
target_rule: Reuse the already frozen V74 REPRESENTATIVE_INSTANCE_LOCK representative_annotation.id and exact bbox for each frame. Do not choose a new largest annotation, nearest cue, GT-best detection, or new query. Missing or nonunique existing target identity becomes a retained no-call UNKNOWN.
target_meaning: The frozen official representative annotation entity. Its equivalence to the initializer-selected physical target remains UNKNOWN unless already explicitly certified; box overlap is diagnostic only.
competitor_rule: Optional one request per existing target: among ALL other official annotation entities of the same image with valid raw positive-area bbox, choose maximum positive raw bbox IoU, exact tie lowest ann_id. Use exact rational arithmetic for selection. No overlap means a retained missing competitor no-call. Another annotation may be the same/merged physical instance.
witness_rule: Inventory only prelocked conditional visible cue records with the same image and an explicit representative_annotation_id equal to this target. Preserve reference and uncertainty regions and original weak AI qualification. No spatially inferred ann_id link, bbox-center positive, nearest cue, or HOLD promotion. A visible region is not a certified occupied pixel; center_pixel_support UNKNOWN cannot become a SAM positive point.
SAM_request_plan: At most 20 target plus 20 optional competitor box requests. Exact raw XYWH and derived XYXY preserved; proposed box-only point_coords=null. Existing cue witnesses are separate evidence and are not automatically point prompts. Root will fix the complete prospective execution policy before any pixels/models.
query_mask_readout: Keep every original query and factual U. No-query/OOB rows cannot gain replacement queries from SAM. A candidate mask is not an official visible/amodal mask; absence never creates external E or geometric S.
provenance: The public feasibility recommendation was fixed before C12 current results, as recorded in the parent task. This preparation uses no current/holdout errors or model scores to select targets, competitors or witnesses.
not_claimed: distinct physical instance from ann_id alone
official visible-own mask from COCO bbox/polygon
exact positive pixel from cue region
operations_allowed: stat existing payload paths without reading payload bytes
write only this new V115 directory
operations_prohibited: source pixel or array payload reads
